title: Concept: Voter identity number in a response
description: A voter id field holding a full document number in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The voter number is an accepted identity proof for account opening, so a leak lets an attacker assemble a false identity with a genuine document reference.
applicability: Deployments that render a voter id field holding a full document number into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The voter number is an accepted identity proof for account opening, so a leak lets an attacker assemble a false identity with a genuine document reference.
